description_ru: Organic deposits: fen (woody sedge peat 2-3 m), peatland (sphagnum over sedge peat 2-4 m), pO-k with thermokarst
note: GSC Maps 1741A-1748A, 1784A (Duk-Rodkin, Hughes et al. 1992-93), Mackenzie Valley 1:250k, raster scans. Shared symbology; per-sheet tints re-sampled. Ground ice from the sheets' own lg01 table (e.g. pO up to 60 % segregated ice, Lp/Mp 10-25 %). Organic 10-50 % = red line overprint (grid / horizontal fen / vertical peat) -> o/<base>, hclass2 O; 2026-10-06: ice_rich cleared (inferred from the unit type; the legend states no ground ice)

description_ru: Alluvial floodplain: coarse sand and gravel with silt and fine sand, 3-5 m; Ap-k with thermokarst (20-50 % segregated ice)
Alluvial terraces: sand and silt over gravel, 2-5 m (Atv 1-2 m)
Alluvial fans and aprons (silt, sand, minor gravel, woody peat) and alluvial complexes
Colluvium and sheetwash: diamicton and rubble; Cb blanket > 3 m, Ca organic-rich silt and sand, Cv veneer 0-2 m
Landslide deposits: rotational slumps and retrogressive thaw flows in glaciolacustrine sediments or shale
Cryoplanation terrace deposits: colluvial rubble 1-3 m
Pediment deposits: silty gravel or colluvium 1-2 m under < 1 m silt; unglaciated mountains
Slope complex: Cb, Cv, Ca, Cz and Af undivided
Glaciolacustrine plain, hummocks and blanket: silt and clay, minor sand; 2-15 m; Lp-k thermokarst (10-25 % segregated ice, up to 50 %)
Glaciolacustrine littoral sediments: low ridges of sand and gravel
Lacustrine complex (lacustrine under up to 3 m sand), Lx-k thermokarst; Lv veneer 0-2 m
Glaciofluvial outwash plain and terrace: sand and gravel, 2-30 m
Ice-contact glaciofluvial hummocks and ridges: gravel and sand, 2-25 m
Glaciofluvial complex: Gh, Gr and kettled Gp, Gt undivided
Moraine plain: till, Mp 3-20 m, Mb 3-6 m, Mpv 1-3 m (10-25 % segregated ice)
Drumlinoid till plain, 2-30 m
note: 2026-10-06: ice_rich cleared (inferred from the unit type; the legend states no ground ice)

description_ru: Thin till and bedrock: till veneer 0-2 m, Mvd over streamlined bedrock
Hummocky, ridged and rolling moraine: coarse till, up to 50-60 m
Glacial deposit complex: hummocky, ridged and rolling till undivided
Bedrock: shale, sandstone, limestone (Paleozoic-Mesozoic); Rt subhorizontal channel-floor surfaces
